capabilities: create daily notes from a specified template
configure the template and target directory per shortcut
launch note creation from a shortcut icon in the right panel
extras: The README is very brief, covering only the settings options and no usage examples.
intentEvidence: Adds the ability to create notes with a specified template according to the described settings.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes do not offer per-shortcut configuration of template and target directory for creating templated daily notes.
summary: Daily note helper that creates a note from a configured template, directory, and ribbon shortcut defined in the plugin settings.
